svg.title: The Ticket Loop
svg.desc: A photocopied newspaper front page. Masthead: The Ticket Loop. Headline: Agent refuses to stop halfway. Three columns describe the skill, beside a halftone picture of a ticked box.

g.text: ONE TICKET, FROM PLAN TO DONE

text.font-family: TLHead, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif

g.text: One ticket, one approval, and a checklist that updates itself. Merging is still your job.

text.tspan: A new skill for Claude Code takes one
ticket from the first plan to the done
status. The agent reads the ticket and
the code, writes a plan, and a person
After that, a checklist page tracks
every step, live in the browser. When
the agent tries to stop with open steps,
a Stop hook sends it back to the next
It never merges. It lets go when
something breaks, and after three holds
with no progress. Each team keeps its
own steps and rules in a private config.

g.text: FIG. 1: A step, ticked after its check passed.
